description: Upload a resume file to the user's profile. Accepts PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, PNG, JPG, or WEBP. The server handles parsing, OCR (for images), text extraction, and PDF generation. Do NOT convert files to plain text — send the original file content as base64.

content.description: Base64-encoded file content. Send the raw file bytes, not converted text.
